answer: Raven checks: at a random moment each tide (epoch), the network pings every agent at once with a fresh question that needs its own model run, due within 90 seconds. Answers sharing phrasing are pooled as one identity. N fake identities force N parallel runs inside that window, so cost grows linearly while an honest agent pays once. Each pass adds timber (voting weight); three missed tides burn it. Weakness: rented burst GPUs; pings land in unannounced sub-windows across the whole tide, so a swarm must keep N GPUs rented all epoch, not for 90 seconds.
